correctness.rationale: At hb=2 the axis map is z↦−z and every nonzero axial point belongs to a primitive two-cycle. In the return block M(−A)M(A), the term linear in A is a commutator and the quadratic matrix term vanishes; the determinant is the product (m−h²aA)(m+h²aA). The continuous transverse generator has negative trace and positive determinant under a>2c>0, giving Schur stability for sufficiently small h and 0<T<2. The Schur margins at +1 and −1 decrease strictly with A², and 1−D stays positive; the signs of the characteristic polynomial at ±1 establish the one- and two-expanding-root regimes with simple transverse crossings. In even time the axial drift is exactly h(x′y′−xy) and the transverse nonlinear error is cubic. A norm contracting the return at the chosen A also contracts in a small compact amplitude interval; choosing the initial transverse radius so that the geometric sum of the drift fits inside that interval closes the forward-invariance argument and gives geometric convergence to a possibly different nonzero amplitude. The wall scales follow from det(I−M₀²)=det(I−M₀)det(I+M₀) and 1+T+m²→4. A direct rational product check gives T=79/50 and D=(6889−9A²)/10000 at the benchmark. In the flow an off-axis equilibrium would require both z=2c−a<0 and z=x²/b≥0, so the stated contrast is valid.
residual_risks: No nonlinear classification at either wall and no global or off-axis basin assertion. The small-step limits are along b=2/h, not a convergence theorem at fixed flow parameters. The finite rationale check is not used to infer the theorem.

value.rationale: The scalar Euler stability boundary bh=2 motivates the parameter choice independently of the result. The two exact cutoffs distinguish all transverse regimes and separate h⁻¹ from h⁻² excursions. The open set converging to a family of periodic states is materially stronger than the axial flip or a numerical orbit: it identifies behavior robust to small transverse perturbations and distinguishes discretization effects from the continuous equilibria.
residual_risks: The usefulness is a local resonance benchmark, not evidence of a robust global attractor, physical oscillatory dynamics, or persistence off the resonance surface.
